spots.name: Vanua Balavu
spots.bio_draft: Island in the northern Lau Group, one of the two main visitor islands with homestays, a guesthouse, Lomaloma port and the Bay of Islands; reached by domestic flight or charter.
spots.reason: Northern Lau island, homestay-based; Lau has no other destination (remote, flights/ferries).

spots.name: Bay of Islands, Vanua Balavu
spots.bio_draft: Natural bay of islets and a limestone cathedral cave with snorkelling, on the northern tip of Vanua Balavu; Wikipedia's Vanua Balavu article gives its other name as Qilaqila, a marine reserve (permission to anchor needed). Reached by yacht, seaplane or charter.
spots.reason: Limestone islets and Cathedral Cave on Vanua Balavu; pinned apart from the island. Lau stays standalone (three kept places on different islands).

spots.name: Lakeba
spots.bio_draft: Island in the southern Lau Group, the administrative and population centre with a weekly flight, homestays and caves, hillforts and Tongan-influenced villages; reached by air or boat.
spots.reason: Southern Lau island; no destination within reach.
